fields.description: Currency cannot store "unset" (the column is NOT NULL 0), and an override of literally 0 đồng is a real case - a package quoted free of charge. This flag says whether price_override means anything.
fields.label: Has Price Override

fields.description: Used only when Has Price Override is set; 0 quotes the package free of charge
fields.label: Price Override

fields.description: Sum of member lines' quote prices
fields.label: Default Price

fields.description: Price − default price; non-zero only when overridden
fields.label: Variance

fields.description: Which phase this package is quoted under. Matched to Deal Phase by name; a package naming no phase, or one that no longer exists, is still quoted - it is money the client is being asked for and never disappears to tidy a layout.
fields.label: Phase

fields.description: How much of it the client is buying - 2, 3, 1. Descriptive only: the price is still the sum of the lines or the override you typed, and nothing multiplies by this.
fields.label: Qty

fields.description: What the quantity counts - ngày quay, video, buổi. Prints only when there is a quantity beside it: a unit on its own is a label nobody asked for.
fields.label: Unit

fields.description: What the client receives, one per line. Prose they read, never something the app counts - so a list rather than a table.
fields.label: Deliverables
